testcase.system-out: Scenario: Inspect the context menu for a browser feature ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is active in the MCAD Software with a solid extrusion ✔ And its extrusion feature is visible in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the extrusion feature in the browser ✔ Then a context menu opens beside the feature row ✔ And the menu offers Edit Sketch, Edit Feature and Show Dimensions ✔ And it offers Copy, Delete, Measure and Properties ✔ And it offers Expand All Children and Collapse All Children ✔ And the extrusion row and the solid edges are highlighted ✔ When the user clicks an empty area of the viewport outside the menu ✔ Then the context menu closes ✔ And the extrusion row and solid edges remain highlighted
